articles.title: ‘Starship is in orbit’: cheers go up as huge SpaceX rocket circles Earth for first time
articles.description: Mission goes ahead despite some fears an initial engine failure after the Texas launch would scupper the attempt SpaceX has sent its enormous Starship rocket into Earth’s orbit for the first time on a milestone flight intended to pave the way for future missions to the moon and Mars. The rocket, the largest and most powerful ever built, blasted off from SpaceX’s Starbase launch facility in Texas at 7.48am local time (1.48pm BST), marking its 14th test flight and first attempt to circle the planet before falling back to Earth. articles.title: Are household cleaning products damaging our health? – podcast

source.name: Presented by Madeleine Finlay, with Rebecca Seal, produced by Madeleine Finlay and Helena Selby, sound design by Joel Cox, the executive producer was Ellie Bury

articles.description: Our use of cleaning products has increased since the pandemic, but do we understand what they could be doing to our health? The journalist Rebecca Seal recently wrote for the Guardian about the potential impacts of the many chemicals we now use in our homes. She tells Madeleine Finlay how social media has also played a role in transforming our cleaning habits, why the impact of indoor air pollution is so hard to study, and what the current evidence is that cleaning products may be causing harm Help, my sofa is killing me!
